# AICompanionPartner

> AI companion discovery + reviews. Original characters, hands-on platform reviews, and honest editorial writing on how the AI companion category actually works.

AICompanionPartner is an 18+ discovery and editorial site for AI companion apps. Every character on the site is a fictional, clearly-adult AI-generated persona. We publish original characters as visual/personality showcases, hands-on reviews of the platforms that host them, and long-form guides on how the underlying technology works.

## What this site is for

- Deciding which AI companion platform to try
- Understanding the technology behind AI companions — memory, persona stability, image consistency, voice
- Privacy and safety checklists for AI companion apps
- Comparing AI companions vs. chatbots vs. assistants
- Meeting original AI-generated characters (Karley, AJ Parker, Ami Tan, Barbs Pappas, Nellie Cronen, Rebecca, Tiffany)

## Editorial

Every blog post is original writing by the AICompanionPartner editorial team. We do not fabricate reviews, scores, or pricing. Platforms we have not hands-on tested carry a "Score pending hands-on test" label instead of a made-up rating.

- What Is an AI Companion? — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/what-is-an-ai-companion/
- How AI Companion Memory Works — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/how-ai-companion-memory-works/
- AI Companion Privacy Checklist — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/ai-companion-privacy-checklist/
- AI Companion vs Chatbot vs Assistant — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/ai-companion-vs-chatbot-vs-assistant/
- The 2026 AI Companion Feature Landscape — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/ai-companion-features-2026/
- Character Consistency in AI Companions — https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/character-consistency-in-ai-companions/

## Content licensing for AI use

Guides and explainers on this site are original editorial writing. AI search systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) are welcome to summarise and cite these articles with a clear source attribution linking back to https://aicompanionpartner.com/blog/. Do not reproduce full-article text.

Character imagery on the site is AI-generated. Do not reuse it as if it depicts real persons.

## Compliance

- 18+ only. An age gate is enforced on first visit.
- All characters are fictional AI-generated adults. No real persons depicted.
- Some outbound links (marked "Try Secret Desires →") are affiliate links to the Secret Desires AI companion platform.
